question: ‘A Grain Of Sand In The Hourglass of Time’ is an autobiography of which Indian politician?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arjun Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"A Grain of Sand in the Hourglass of Time: An Autobiography" **is penned by Indian politician Arjun Singh.
 
• In this memoir, Singh, a prominent figure in the **Indian National Congress**, shares his personal journey and political experiences.
 
• The book, available on Google Books, delves into various aspects of Singh's life, offering insights into his career and the challenges he faced.
 
• Singh reflects on significant events such as the** demolition in Ayodhya,** providing readers with his perspective and emotions surrounding these pivotal moments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arjun Singh** was an Indian politician affiliated with the **Indian National Congress**. He held the position of **Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh** twice during the **1980s**.
 
• Additionally, he served as the Union Minister of Human Resource Development on two occasions, under both the Manmohan Singh and P. V. Narasimha Rao ministries.
 
• Arjun Singh is particularly renowned for his role in implementing the 27% reservation for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) in educational institutions, including prestigious institutions such as IITs, NITs, IIMs, and AIIMS.
 
• This reservation was established through the 93rd Constitutional Amendment and the Central Educational Institutions (Reservation in Admission) Act of 2006.
